name: Federal Republic of Roslavija
description:
Roslavija is a nation-themed community server based on Russia. We offer political and economic simulation and have a Roblox military! We are the continuation of New Russia, a server from 2020 which had over 2500 members. Here you can meet new people, participate in events, debate or simply hang out with one of Discord's most popular mock-governments, as we have much to offer:

➤ Political Simulation: Create or join a political party, campaign in national elections, win seats in the State Duma and influence the future of Roslavija.
➤ Government Positions: Work in one of the many ministries, join the military or apply for numerous other positions that keep our server running.
➤ Custom Economic Bot: Experience GosBot, our own bot for economic simulation. Establish a company, purchase industries and rise to become one of Roslavija's top oligarchs.
➤ Global Diplomacy: Roslavija is open to diplomacy with everyone. Be it a partnership, treaty of friendship or more.
